videos.script: Three weeks before São João, Celeste asked Tainá one question. Will it hold? {{title}} Nobody could answer from memory. The system had changed all year, one pull request at a time. {{changed}} An architecture review is the way to answer that question on purpose. You take the qualities that matter, walk them through the design, and find where it is weak before the peak finds it for you. {{review}} This lesson starts with the heavy method, ATAM, because its ideas are in every lighter one. Risks. Sensitivity points. Trade-offs. {{atam}} Then two lighter methods a small team can run in an afternoon. {{light}} Then the checklist, and how to write findings that somebody will act on. {{findings}} And it ends with the ways reviews go wrong, which are mostly about people.
